About.title: About Find My School Mongolia
About.intro: Choosing or changing schools is a big decision, and the information is scattered. This site puts the basics in one place — curriculum, languages, fees, dormitories — next to reviews from the people who actually attend the schools.
About.useBody: <search>Search</search> by name, school number, or district, and narrow by level, type, curriculum, or dormitory. Save schools to come back to them, <compare>compare</compare> up to three side by side, or see them on the <map>map</map>.
About.verifiedBody: To write a review you sign in with your school email and confirm it with a one-time code. You can only review the school that email belongs to, so every review comes from someone who's actually there.
About.ratingsBody: Reviewers score academics, facilities, teachers, and campus environment from 1 to 5; library and dormitory scores are optional. A school's overall rating is the average of the four main categories. Each person reviews a school once and can delete their review from <myReviews>My reviews</myReviews>.
About.moderationBody: An admin reads every new review before it's published, and only approved reviews count toward a school's rating. Reviews reflect the views of individual community members, not this site. If a published review is spam, abusive, or about a different school, use the Report link on it and a moderator will take a look.
